description: This PHP class defines a form for configuring installation settings in the Revive Adserver project, including admin account details, web paths, and localization options.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Install_ConfigForm
classes.description: A PHP class for creating and managing the installation configuration form in the Revive Adserver admin UI.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with admin, path, and localization settings.

methods.name: buildAdminSection
methods.description: Builds the admin account input fields and validation rules.

methods.name: buildPathsConfigurationSection
methods.description: Builds the web path configuration input fields and validation rules.

methods.name: buildPreviousPathSection
methods.description: Builds the input field for previous installation path.

methods.name: populateConfig
methods.description: Exports form values into a structured configuration array.

methods.name: populateForm
methods.description: Populates the form with existing configuration data.
